known_issues: PREVIEW firmware only: not stable, not recommended, not a customer default, not hardware verified, and not buyable.
Hardware, bench, mains-safety, and compliance evidence remain stable-only blockers; no such proof is claimed by this release.

The FanDAC artifacts (`Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-FanDAC-RoomIQ`, `Ceiling-POE-AirIQ-FanDAC-RoomIQ`) require the GP8403 IC2 `0x5A` address override and a matching S360-312 IC2 DIP switch (IC1 `0x58`; `0x59` is forbidden — it collides with the air-quality SGP41 at `0x59`). The DIP-position to address mapping is NOT bench verified; `FANDAC-I2C-ADDR-001` stays pending.
`Ceiling-POE-VentIQ-FanTRIAC-RoomIQ` is excluded because `HW-005` still blocks buildability.

These room-bundle fan artifacts share the `v1.0.0-preview` preview release with the room-bundle and LED preview artifacts. WebFlash import eligibility is controlled separately by WebFlash import policy; presence in this shared release does not make them WebFlash one-click imports, and no fan row is added to `config/webflash-builds.json`.
